correctness.rationale: Plane waves on N-cycle with flux φ have E_k=−2J cos[(2πk+φ)/N]. Degeneracy of distinct k occurs only at φ=0,π; paired indices l≡−q−k at φ=qπ. A dark vector in each paired eigenspace is (|k>−|l>)/√2, and its second-detector cancellation is equivalent to N|d(2k+q). Counting solutions excluding fixed pairs gives D_0=(gcd(N,2d)−gcd(N,2))/2; at π, if N/gcd(N,d) even none, else the stated odd/even N dimensions. The character-sum overlap (1/2N)∑_{k∈Ωq}(1−cos(2π(2k+q)j/N)) yields every site weight and the nonmonotone flux switching. A dissipative generator has purely imaginary eigenmodes precisely in the reducing dark space; nonresonant projective sampling has no extra unimodular eigenvectors. Thus both survival limits are dark-projector weights; coprimality iff no dark at any flux. Independently evaluated Fourier sums for all N=3..28, every spacing d, both fluxes, every j: 15366 checks.
